import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(10,5))
# Plan view
ax1.set_title("Plan - crate racks + aisle")
ax1.set_xlim(0, 3.0); ax1.set_ylim(0, 2.2)
# walls
ax1.plot([0.1,2.7,2.7,0.1,0.1],[0.1,0.1,2.1,2.1,0.1], 'k-', lw=2)
# left rack
ax1.text(0.5,1.1,"LEFT RACK\n25 crates", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)
ax1.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.2,0.25),0.8,1.6, fill=False, lw=2))
# right rack
ax1.text(2.0,1.1,"RIGHT RACK\n25 crates", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)
ax1.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1.6,0.25),0.8,1.6, fill=False, lw=2))
# aisle
ax1.text(1.4,1.1,"AISLE", ha='center', rotation=90, fontsize=8)
ax1.annotate("HINGED DOOR\n800 wide", xy=(1.4,0.1), xytext=(1.4,-0.25), ha='center', fontsize=8, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax1.annotate("100mm PU wall", xy=(0.1,1.5), xytext=(-0.6,1.7), fontsize=8, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax1.set_aspect('equal'); ax1.axis('off')
# Section view
ax2.set_title("Section - shade roof + airflow gap")
ax2.set_xlim(0,3); ax2.set_ylim(0,3)
ax2.plot([0.3,2.7],[2.0,2.0],'k-',lw=3)
ax2.text(1.5,2.15,"100mm PU ROOF", ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.plot([0.2,2.8],[2.6,2.6],'k-',lw=2)
ax2.text(1.5,2.75,"PV SHADE ROOF\nvented gap 150", ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.plot([0.3,0.3],[0.2,2.0],'k-',lw=3); ax2.plot([2.7,2.7],[0.2,2.0],'k-',lw=3)
ax2.text(0.15,1.0,"PU WALL", rotation=90, fontsize=7, ha='center')
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.5,0.3),0.7,1.2, fill=False, lw=2))
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1.8,0.3),0.7,1.2, fill=False, lw=2))
ax2.text(0.85,0.9,"CRATES\non racks", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax2.text(2.15,0.9,"CRATES\non racks", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax2.text(1.5,0.5,"AISLE + FAN AIRFLOW", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax2.annotate("", xy=(1.5,0.7), xytext=(0.9,0.7), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->'))
ax2.annotate("", xy=(1.5,2.4), xytext=(1.5,2.05), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->'))
ax2.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("sketch.png", dpi=150)
